Before you visit

A Few Helpful Answers

Still curious? Call our salon and a member of the Daisy team will help you plan your visit.

+232 345 6789

Weekday appointments are often available within a few days. For evenings, weekends and bridal services, we recommend booking two to four weeks ahead.

Please give us at least 24 hours’ notice when plans change. Late cancellations may require a fee before a new appointment is confirmed.

We work with professional formulas selected for performance and comfort. Your specialist will always explain what is being used and adapt to known sensitivities.

Our bridal package includes a dedicated trial so we can refine your look, timing and product choices well before the day.

Yes. Complimentary guest parking is available beside the salon. Let us know if you need step-free access when booking.
